svg.title: Chapter 4, the opportunity: speak their language first. Before confusion begins, speak their language. Recommendation 1, a language picker at onboarding (screen 1): during the very first session ask the student to choose a preferred language for explanations (English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Marathi or Bengali) and store it on the user profile, which today shows class and grade but no language preference. One question, one screen, zero friction added. Metric: percentage of users who choose a language other than English, a proxy for latent demand. Recommendation 2, bilingual notes first, dubbed audio second: the Learn tab already has a Notes section, so translated concept notes are low cost (text, not a new recording) and ship faster; Watch tab videos can add a language toggle in a later sprint. Metric: notes open rate by language segment against the English only baseline. Recommendation 3, doubt resolution in the preferred language: a language aware doubt chat using LLM powered responses, so a question asked in Hindi gets an answer in Hindi. Metric: support ticket volume drop and session length increase after launch. The proposed order: pick a language, learn, then choose. Expected outcome: students experience value sooner, understand faster and build trust before being asked to commit.

section.div: The opportunity · enter the product manager
section.h2: Before confusion begins, speak their language.

div.p: Screen 1 of the first session asks for a preferred language for explanations, then stores it on the profile (today it shows class and grade, but no language). One question, one screen, zero friction added.
div.div: Metric% of users choosing a language other than English: a proxy for latent demand

div.h3: Bilingual notes first, dubbed audio second
div.p: The Learn tab already has Notes. Translating concept notes is low cost (text, not a new recording) and ships faster. Watch tab videos can add a language toggle in a later sprint.
div.div: MetricNotes open rate by language segment, against the English only baseline

div.p: A language aware doubt chat with LLM powered responses: ask in Hindi, get the answer in Hindi. Achievable with LLM tooling today, and ALLEN's brand trust does the rest.
div.div: MetricSupport ticket volume drop, and session length increase after launch

section.p: Expected outcome: students experience value sooner, understand faster, and build trust before being asked to commit.
